cases.name: EVOX Production LLC v. Midjourney, Inc.
Warner Bros. Entertainment Inc. v. Midjourney, Inc.
Disney Enterprises, Inc. and Universal v. Midjourney, Inc.

profile_text.body:
Midjourney is a for-profit independent research lab founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as exploring new mediums of thought and expanding the imaginative powers of the human species, with projects organized around themes it names as imagination, coordination, reflection, beauty, and human flourishing.

The company's primary tracked product is Midjourney, an AI image generation tool categorized under image and graphic design, available at its main website. IP provenance has been noted as a relevant consideration for the product.

Midjourney faces substantial litigation exposure, with 139 cases recorded in California. These include suits in the Central District of California brought by EVOX Production LLC, Warner Bros. Entertainment Inc., and a combined action by Disney Enterprises, Inc. and Universal, all naming Midjourney, Inc. as a defendant. The company is also named as a party in Andersen v. Stability AI Ltd., filed in the Northern District of California, a case that encompasses multiple AI image generation defendants.
